scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-smartshare-rules "node --test tests/firestore-rules/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions ci && npx -y firebase-tools@15 deploy --only functions
scripts.test:functions:emulator: npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-smartshare-fn "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions:emulator && ng build --configuration production
scripts.deploy:hosting: ng build --configuration production && npx -y firebase-tools@15 deploy --only hosting
